# Core vocabulary {#sec-vocab-core}

[Normative]{.status}

Terms used by every other module: the participants in the framework and the common building blocks of time and place.

## Candidate terms

::: {.callout-note title="Placeholder"}
This section is a placeholder.
The terms, meanings and sources below are candidates and have not been agreed.
:::

| Term | Meaning | Possible source |
|---|---|---|
| Vessel | A ship or boat taking part in the framework | NMEA data dictionary — *to be confirmed* |
| Organization | A provider, operator or other body | schema.org `Organization` |
| Person | An individual, for example an observer | schema.org `Person` |
| Position | A point on the Earth's surface, with accuracy | *To be decided* |
| Area | A region, for example a management zone | schema.org `GeoShape` — *to be confirmed* |
| Time | An instant or interval | ISO 8601 / `xsd:dateTime` |
